summary: Man in his early 70s from out of state fell ill about 1,000 ft below the Quandary Peak summit while attempting his first 14er; Good Samaritans escorted him down toward Highway 9 and Flight for Life airlifted him to St. Anthony Summit Medical Center.
location: Quandary Peak Trail, ~1,000 ft below summit
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group / Flight for Life
notes: Same SnowBrains article as the Buffalo Mountain incident (shared-page source); call received 10:22 am Friday. Run 1018 chunk B.
